title: Spinach dal with brown-style rice
summary: Spinach dal with brown-style rice is a indian dinner built around dried red lentils and baby spinach, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Spinach dal with brown-style rice. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add dried red lentils and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and baby spinach.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until basmati rice is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Spinach dal with brown-style rice before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Spinach dal with brown-style rice.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
